items.comments: I might be the first guest of this great place. Lucky me! It's in a quite area with short drive distance to almost all Seattle attractions. The house is even more beautiful than the pictures. Jeffrey is a great person willing to provide best hospitality to his guest. He is also provide very detailed instruction for his home. All the facilities are very good.
Excellent host, excellent house, excellent neighborhood. Every detail has been thought through. It really is an urban oasis.

My family and I had a very nice experience at Jeffrey's home in Queen Anne. The house was very nice with a great backyard area. The location was perfect as it is close to downtown Seattle but still has a nice quiet feel to it.

Jeffrey's house was beautiful and in great condition.  It had an amazing, tranquil backyard.  Description and pictures of the house were accurate.  Jeffrey was super thoughtful in stocking the home with essentials and niceties for us to use.  He was very responsive to all of our questions.

Four of us stayed here for three nights and it was fantastic. Jeffrey was very helpful and responsive throughout the entire process. The house is great, with a private backyard area, very comfortable beds and lots of space. The location is also excellent. We had never been to Seattle before, so we had to take a (semi-educated) guess at where in the city we wanted to stay and I'm glad we chose here. The neighborhood is quiet at night, it feels safe, and it's easy to hop on a bus to head anyhwere you want to go. I would stay here again for sure, and I highly recommend it.
Jeffrey is a great host!  His home is very nice, clean, and comfortable!
